text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Ngh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
(I was unable to claim victory... How

disappointing.)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Satsuki Sho over, I head out to
greet
Mejiro Ardan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I'm terribly sorry for such a disappointing

performance.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
Far from outshining the crown jewel, I
only
managed to showcase how dull my
light remains...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
In no way did I perform to the best of my
current
ability...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Although it looks like her frustration has kept her from realizing it, Mejiro Ardan has just returned with dignity after participating in the Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After her debut race, she outright
collapsed from
exhaustion. But now,
even after having finished a
G1 race, she
stands strong.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
That she can now compete in G1 races is
a
testament to how much she's grown!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text: ...It's very much like you to say that.
choice_data_list: 今日の経験を活かして精進しよう
choice_data_list_en: Let's build on today's experience and keep improving.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
It's precisely because you always have
your sights
on what's ahead that I can
continue moving
forward as well.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
When I run in the Aoba Sho, I shall not
repeat any
of the mistakes I made today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ardan
text_block_list.text:
I ask that you continue to provide me
with your
guidance and support.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With the Aoba Sho right around the
corner,
Mejiro Ardan has shown me how
committed she is
to delivering results
that'll put us in good stead
for the
Japanese Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
I was in perfect form today. There was
no way I
could've run any better.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: But I was bested all the same...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: And not only that...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
Ardan was sharp as a blade. I felt her
pressure
throughout the whole race.

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
And she, too, will surely utilize what she
has
learned today to push herself harder
still...

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text:
But things will not play out this way at
the
Japanese Derby!

text_block_list.name: Yaeno Muteki
text_block_list.text: Next time... I will prevail!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
Ardan, Yaeno... Even now, I can still feel
the
intensity of their running...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I just know that their skills will be even
more
polished when the Derby comes
around!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
I can't afford to rest on my laurels! I have
to aim
higher—far higher than now, for
someplace
beyond even their grasp!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I have to, otherwise...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My wish to be like my role model... to
catch up to
her...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text:
My wish to win the race she yearns for...
All my
feelings... The vow I made...
They'll all be for
nothing!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I can't let that happen!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Chiyono O
text_block_list.text: I have to train even, even more!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With each of the three racers harboring
their own
aspirations, the Japanese
Derby draws ever
closer...
